instruction: I prefer using VLC in a minimal interface mode to maximize screen space when watching videos. Can you enable the minimal view mode in VLC?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC (qt-minimal-view=1). Evaluator uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric and get_vlc_config getter to read VLC configuration file and verify qt-minimal-view setting is set to 1. Default value is 0 (disabled), so the agent must navigate to Tools > Preferences > Interface and enable minimal view mode. This is similar in complexity to the original task (changing a single VLC configuration setting).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable minimal view mode in VLC
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC config file from OS-specific locations
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly checks qt-minimal-view setting with proper default handling (defaults to '0' if not found)
Expected value is semantically correct: qt-minimal-view=1 means minimal view enabled
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure configuration changes are persisted to disk
Complete coverage: instruction asks to enable minimal view, evaluator verifies qt-minimal-view=1
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly as expected when type='rule'
